prompt: Create a premium collectible hobby illustration. The artwork should feel cinematic, aspirational, emotionally warm, commercially polished, and immediately readable on a small mobile card. Use a strong focal subject, crisp subject separation, rich but controlled colour, atmospheric depth, premium lighting, and clear visual storytelling. Sell the emotional fantasy of doing the hobby rather than merely depicting an object. Aim for the feel of a miniature lifestyle poster or hero illustration inside one coherent collectible-art universe. Keep edges and subject readability cleaner than soft editorial painting. No text, no logo, no typography, no card border, no rarity badge, no watermark, no UI.
global_negatives: duplicated key objects unless explicitly requested
pseudo-text or gibberish lettering anywhere in the image
readable real-world brand names, logos, or trademarks
recognisable copyrighted film/game/cartoon characters or franchise costumes
collage, split-screen, comic-panel, or multi-panel layouts
photoreal stock-photo rendering unless explicitly requested by the hobby recipe
reference_instruction: Use the supplied reference image only as a visual-style guide. Match its commercial-cinematic illustration language, crisp hero framing, rich atmospheric lighting, polished color grading, and collectible desirability. Do not copy its subjects, exact compositions, card frames, typography, handwritten slogans, logos, rarity labels, or UI.
